_comment: The Model Rules layer: a draft rule set circulated for public inputs, kept as
markdown rather than Akoma Ntoso because it is not an instrument in force. When a
State notifies it, it graduates to data/policy/ as AKN and leaves here.
The source is a Google Doc with tabs, and every tab is one file here and one
sub-tab in the app. The app builds its tab strip from this list and nothing else,
so adding a tab is a new file plus an entry below - never a code change. Order
here is the order on screen; the first entry is the tab the page opens on.
label: Model Rules
lede: A model rule set a State's High Court could adopt to run a 24x7 ON Court, drafted under Article 227 of the Constitution and section 523 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

It is a draft out for public inputs, not law in force, so it belongs with the other things a build is measured against rather than with the corpus of instruments. Every tab of the source document is a tab here.

source.made_under: Article 227 of the Constitution of India and section 523 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, with the previous approval of the Governor of [State Name]
source.note: Transcribed from the source document as it reads with its suggested edits shown. Comment threads on the source are not carried over.

tabs.title: Draft Rules
tabs.desc: The draft rules themselves: four Parts, twenty-seven rule groups and six Annexures, covering a case from filing to disposal in a 24x7 ON Court.

tabs.title: Objects & Reasons
tabs.desc: The drafters' own account of what the rules change and the principles they were drafted on.
